text:
Hannah: Rain check! Rode the 7:10 ferry and it was a mess	line wrapped around the kiosk. Anyone else running late?
commute-bot: FERRY NOTICE: Pier 6 heavy volumes; expect 20-40m boarding delays. Recommended alternate: Pier 2.
Luis: Took the shuttle instead, but it hit major traffic on 101. Felt like a parking lot until the Bay Bridge clearance. :tired_face:
Kae: BART at Embarcadero had a single-track delay this morning, train held for 12m. App warned late but not early enough. :grimacing:
Riley: Lost an umbrella to the wind tunnel near the lookout. If you find a black compact umbrella with a sticker "Riley", DM pls. :umbrella:
office-admin: Heads up		lower garage sump pump tripped earlier; maintenance said they mopped but there might be damp spots near elevator 3. Avoid the left row if you can.
Hannah: Thanks @office-admin. Also cafe ran out of napkins because everyone was drying shoes. Cute chaos.
Luis: I left a pair of spare shoe inserts in the kitchen labeled "soggy emergency". Help yourselves.
Kae: :raised_hands: grabbing some after standup. Also note: the north bike rack flooded, locked bikes might be muddy.
Riley: Photo: ```IMG_7642.jpg - umbrella stuck in decorative bush, rescuer pending```
commute-bot: MUNI: Routes 8X & 30 experiencing 10-20m delays due to signal issues near 4th St.
Hannah: Mini-poll: Quick "dry gear swap" at 11:45 in the lobby? React with :handshake: to join, :no_entry_sign: if tied up.
Luis: :handshake:
Kae: :handshake:
Riley: :no_entry_sign: in a meeting, but will try to swing by after.
office-admin: We'll put a drying rack by reception and some paper towels. If anyone wants to donate spare socks or shoe covers, drop them in the labelled box.
Hannah: Also FYI	I saw a tiny pop-up giving out hot cider by Pier 6 that must've been the crowd magnet. Worth the wait if you like cider.
commute-bot: NOTE: Pier 6 volume expected to normalize by 09:40. Ops monitoring.
